ainglish:
Each pair below gives the false and true readings of one field. Both languages are defined explicitly; this is reference-assisted interpretation, not cold reading.
include_recipient: false = we-excluding-you; true = we-including-you.
finish_deadline: false = start-by(18:00 UTC); true = complete-by(18:00 UTC).
collective: false = each-alone; true = as-one.
both_allowed: false = red or blue, not-both; true = red or blue, or-both.
old_A_active: false = C: supersedes(A): perform the named check; true = C: supplements(A): perform the named check.
english:
Each pair below gives the false and true readings of one field. Both languages are defined explicitly; this is reference-assisted interpretation, not cold reading.
include_recipient: false = the acting team excludes you; true = the acting team includes you.
finish_deadline: false = the check must start by 18:00 UTC; true = the check must successfully finish by 18:00 UTC.
collective: false = each team member performs their own named check; true = the team performs one collective named check.
both_allowed: false = choose exactly one of red and blue; true = choose red or blue or both.
old_A_active: false = C replaces A with the instruction to perform the named check; true = C adds the instruction to perform the named check while A remains active.
